rationale: Retain registered incumbent program_20 unchanged for a fresh paired generation comparison; updates are empty. Observed discovery mean predicted pIC50 delta is +0.23030, validity change +0.010, and MMFF relief per heavy median/p90 are 0.47695/0.95455. Its mean is only about 0.001 above program_3 (+0.22929) and program_4 (+0.22936), without independent uncertainty. Regional program_19 has lower affinity delta (+0.21284) and lower strain p90 (0.90787); program_8 has still lower p90 (0.73102) but lower affinity delta (+0.13900). Thus discovery supports testing the incumbent, not superiority or strain non-regression; the affinity-primary objective and absent material-regression criterion do not justify a scalar change. Observed reduced x/y spread and altered pair kernels are correlated selection associations. The information audit shows compressed teacher choice differs from full geometry (top-four overlap 0.470, excess fixed RMS 0.081 A), but supplies no causal affinity benefit or identified modes. Regional enrichment and opposite local y contrasts do not establish added benefit beyond global geometry or an attraction direction. Node sign reversals and all 24 failed fitted-curve certificates counter fixed or fitted stage rules. The significant landmark_00 softmin increment describes endpoint forecast changes, not physical velocities or a spatial gradient; survival enrichment q=0.12043 and sparse ancestry do not establish future affinity credit. These observations do not justify adding regional, history or terminal weighting to this candidate. Design: Y_t is the native predicted endpoint in world angstrom coordinates. Use the registered endpoint_pointcloud observable q_m=mean_i||Y_t,i-teacher_m,assignment(i)||^2, with Hungarian squared-distance assignment, K=4 nearest teachers and costs C_m computed from detached Y_t. Keep detached pi_m=softmax(-C_m/4.0+2.0*(s_m-mean(s))+optional registered teacher_base_log_weight_m), and R=0.5*logsumexp(log(pi_m)-rho_2(q_m)/0.5), where rho_2(q)=4*(sqrt(1+q/4)-1). Reference is the registered endpoint_reference.json.gz (SHA256 d706173b74a937c5becac08ccbcff187f48e50ca3303d9021667e466fa5fb77c). K=4, endpoint temperature 4.0 A^2, score beta=2.0, mixture temperature=0.5, native_rms_ratio=0.33 and time_ramp_power=0.0 are inherited registered experimental choices, not estimated optima; robust_delta=2 and constraints are inherited from the hash-verified program. Apply only at exact learned nodes t=0.00,...,0.49 in [0,0.5]; use native continuation outside this support. Backpropagate g_t=J_FLOWR_endpoint(X_t)^T grad_Y R through the existing native forward graph, with zero additional production forward calls and no affinity-head gradient, SMC or graph veto. Preserve relative RMS dose and bounded backtracking, including seven attempts and 0.15 A atom-step cap. Multiplying the reward is not assumed to increase a normalized-gradient dose. Validation hypotheses: on fresh paired independent generation batches, this unchanged reward maintains or improves final mean predicted affinity over all attempts while physical strain median, p90 and extreme tails do not materially regress against the paired native baseline. Predeclare missing-score/failure accounting and a material-strain margin; report validity and missingness separately, without silently dropping failures or assigning missing labels an affinity value. Record delivered update RMS, clipping/backtracking and teacher choices to distinguish a weak delivered dose from an unsuitable target. No inference or generation is performed here.
failure_modes: Adaptive reused discovery batches and absent paired uncertainty can make the apparent affinity gain disappear on fresh independent batches.
Coordinate proximity and recorded teacher scores may capture selection biases rather than final affinity; geometric improvement can coexist with worse affinity.
Untyped Hungarian correspondence, teacher switches and a mixture of nearby endpoints can yield unsuitable deformations; observed summaries do not establish chemically compatible modes.
Normalized RMS dosing, atom-step clipping and backtracking can change delivered displacement; larger requested dose or whole-reward scaling is not guaranteed to improve quality.
World-frame pose mismatch or endpoint-VJP amplification can move surrounding coordinates incompatibly and worsen clashes or strain tails.
Sparse teacher/ancestor support, correlated descriptors and local node sign reversals limit extrapolation; absent terminal affinity labels cannot establish future credit.
Missing affinity/failure handling, raw physical tails, baseline strain and a material-regression margin are absent from the supplied discovery summaries, so non-regression is unverified.
